meta.title: A Custom Ultra-Low-Cost 3D Bioprinter Supports Cell Growth and Differentiation.

extracted_by: Claude (Claude Code session), pending human review
summary: A custom ultra-low-cost bioprinter was built and tested with mouse radial glial neural stem cells and mesenchymal stem cells in alginate/gelatin inks; cells grew and kept their ability to differentiate.

formulations.name: 0.8% alginate + 0.5% gelatin (radial glia)
formulations.key_outcome: A very cheap custom printer supported neural stem cell growth and differentiation.

evidence.quote: a 0.8% (w/v) sodium alginate and 0.5% (w/v) gelatin bioink was synthesized for the pRGCs
in this case a 25-gauge needle with 0.26 mm diameter
primary radial glial (pRGCs) stem cells, a neural stem cell population derived from mice subventricular zone
